research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Zocdoc is researching systems for healthcare appointment information management, as described in 'System and Method for Accessing Healthcare Appointments from Multiple Disparate Sources,' which enables patients to manage multiple accounts and preferences through a single account. Additionally, 'Aggregatory System for Enabling Online Access to Encounter Data from Multiple Disparate Sources' details methods for synchronizing and aggregating encounter data across various healthcare sources. These efforts focus on unified access and data integration.

Zocdoc was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in New York.

about_short_description.short_description: Zocdoc is a digital marketplace company that connects healthcare patients and doctors.

product.name: Zocdoc Healthcare Marketplace
product.description: A digital healthcare marketplace that helps patients find doctors, dentists, and other providers by location, specialty, insurance, availability, visit type, and patient reviews.

product.name: Zocdoc Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application for finding providers, booking appointments, viewing appointment availability, and managing scheduled healthcare visits.

product.name: Zocdoc for Private Practices
product.description: A provider-facing service that enables private practices to list their services, reach prospective patients, fill appointment openings, and collect verified patient reviews.

product.name: Zocdoc Enterprise Solutions
product.description: A healthcare-organization service that helps health systems connect patients with participating providers and manage digital appointment access across larger provider networks.

product.name: Zocdoc EHR Integrations
product.description: Integration services that connect healthcare providers' electronic health record systems with Zocdoc for appointment and practice workflow coordination.
